name: Animate UI
summary: Motion-powered open React components via @animate-ui shadcn registry (primitives + composed UI).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry items of ~580 listed in registry.json; not a full inventory.
License is MIT + Commons Clause (LICENSE.md) — not pure SPDX MIT; free use in apps/products, Commons Clause restricts selling/redistributing components themselves as a competing bundle.
No separate paid unlock found on animate-ui.com during research — pricing=free; Pro companion not observed (unlike React Bits / Kokonut).
Namespaced registry `@animate-ui` resolves via shadcn public registries (url https://animate-ui.com/r/{name}.json).
ARCHITECTURE §5 prefers iframe for unusual/tactile motion; all demos are docs iframes.
Some composed buttons (flip/ripple) pull extra @animate-ui registryDependencies (primitives + button base).

components.name: Typing Text
components.summary: Typing text animation with optional cursor, loop, and in-view trigger.

demo.peerNotes: Also exports TypingTextCursor; registry pulls hooks-use-is-in-view + lib-get-strict-context.

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @animate-ui/primitives-texts-typing

import { TypingText } from "@/components/animate-ui/primitives/texts/typing"

<TypingText text="Animate UI" duration={100} loop={true} holdDelay={1000} />

copyPrompt.text: Use Animate UI free component `Typing Text` (registry `primitives-texts-typing`) from https://animate-ui.com/docs/primitives/texts/typing. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @animate-ui/primitives-texts-typing` after `npx shadcn@latest init` (official registry namespace `@animate-ui` → `https://animate-ui.com/r/{name}.json`). Registry item: https://animate-ui.com/r/primitives-texts-typing.json. Import `TypingText` from `@/components/animate-ui/primitives/texts/typing` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; most items need `motion`. License: MIT + Commons Clause (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imskyleen/animate-ui/main/LICENSE.md) — free for use in apps/websites/products; do not sell/redistribute the components themselves as a competing library/bundle. Prefer free-tier only.
